# Joshua Lavieri

> Personal site of Joshua Lavieri, an infrastructure and platform engineer.
> Projects, writing, and a resume. Built with Astro, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.
> English at /, Afrikaans at /af/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://joshualavieri.com/): Introduction and a brief career timeline.
- [Projects](https://joshualavieri.com/projects/): Projects built and in progress, with demo and source links.
- [About me](https://joshualavieri.com/me/): Longer personal background.
- [Resume](https://joshualavieri.com/resume/): Work history, roles, and technologies.
- [Blog](https://joshualavieri.com/blog/): Posts, tag-filterable.
